last.verdict: Investors looked past soft Q4 profit guidance to record revenue growth and a stronger sales outlook.

reasons.label: Record revenue growth
reasons.text: Q3 revenue rose 17% to $17.9 billion, the best unit revenue growth since the pandemic.

reasons.label: Q4 sales accelerating
reasons.text: United expects Q4 revenue growth of over 20%, faster than Q3's 17%.

reasons.label: Fuel squeezing profit
reasons.text: Fuel expense jumped 62%; adjusted EPS of $2.54 sat slightly under the roughly $2.58 expected.

story: Fuel costs have dominated 2026. In April United cut its full-year profit outlook and shares fell over 6%. In July it beat estimates and raised its outlook despite about $6 billion in extra fuel costs. Revenue growth has since accelerated to 17%.
